name: Claudius
description: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament

points: Agabus signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world, which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar. Understand that Caligula was Caesar when this was prophesied; Claudius came into power four or five years later, and that is when the famine hit, around AD 45 to 46. This is why, when we tell you to prepare, black people say it did not happen this year or next, so it is not going to happen. This did not occur for five years. Just listen closely when we tell you things.

In those days prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch, and one named Agabus signified by the Spirit that there would be a great dearth throughout all the world, which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar. This famine is historically documented; Elliott's commentary notes the frequent famines of Claudius's reign, and Josephus records a famine affecting Judea and Syria under the procurator Cuspius Fadus around AD 45, when Queen Helena of Adiabene sent supplies of corn and figs, again giving validity to the Bible as an accurate history book.

note.label: Acts 11: The Gentiles Are Scattered Israel

points: Because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome: this is Claudius Caesar.
I'm just going to show y'all. Claudius was not Caesar in Acts 11. That was Caligula.
Claudius Caesar commanded that all the Jews had to get kicked out of Rome, because the Jews, the Israelites, were all throughout Rome.

After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth; and found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome.

note.label: Israel Called Gentiles, Strangers, Heathen & Saints

points: There is nothing new under the sun; the same thing that was done is the same thing that shall be done. “Because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome.” Trump said there will be mass deportation, and Claudius Caesar deported every last Jew living in Rome: all of you get out of my country, we don’t want you here. It is the same thing you are seeing today.

Notice it says Claudius deported all Jews and doesn’t say anything about the other nations living in Rome. The same Jews deported under ancient Rome are the same Jews being deported under America. The Lord is showing you who he is doing this to, his intended target.
